telegramScheduleSchema: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS telegram_schedule_local (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(id=1), token TEXT NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS telegram_policy_local (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(id=1), interval_minutes INTEGER NOT NULL, next_at INTEGER NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS telegram_outbox_local (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, day TEXT NOT NULL, payload TEXT NOT NULL,
attempted INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, retry_at INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, UNIQUE(day,attempted));
setTelegramSchedule: INSERT INTO telegram_schedule_local VALUES(1,@token) ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET token=excluded.token
getTelegramSchedule: SELECT token FROM telegram_schedule_local WHERE id=1
getTelegramPolicy: SELECT interval_minutes,next_at FROM telegram_policy_local WHERE id=1
setTelegramPolicy: INSERT INTO telegram_policy_local VALUES(1,@minutes,@now) ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET
next_at=CASE WHEN interval_minutes=excluded.interval_minutes THEN next_at ELSE excluded.next_at END,
advanceTelegramPolicy: UPDATE telegram_policy_local SET next_at=@next WHERE id=1
clearTelegramPolicy: DELETE FROM telegram_policy_local; DELETE FROM telegram_outbox_local;
queueTelegramJob: ON CONFLICT(day,attempted) DO UPDATE SET id=excluded.id,payload=excluded.payload
findTelegramJob: SELECT j.id,j.payload FROM telegram_outbox_local j WHERE j.retry_at<=@now
AND (j.attempted=1 OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM telegram_outbox_local p WHERE p.day=j.day AND p.attempted=1))
markTelegramJob: UPDATE telegram_outbox_local SET attempted=1,retry_at=@retry WHERE id=@id
